comments.text: Mowing the lawn on a Sunday being enough to annoy the neighbors made me laugh 😂 Austria really does take quiet time seriously. Is Sunday actually that quiet where you live?

comments.author: @CulturalTravel4K

comments.text: Living here for a few years now, and this documentary captures it so well! The quality of life, the stunning nature, and the peaceful vibe are hard to beat. However, the bureaucracy and making local friends can definitely be a bit challenging at first. Totally worth it though! 🇦🇹✨
